olivia (sales): CedarBank POC: intermittent slow TTFT during interactive demo (typical 120ms, spikes 700-1500ms). Can eng swarm before 17:30 call?
ben (eng-runtime): Which pool/model? Any traces?
olivia (sales): Hosted us-east, pool cedar-demo-v3, model redwood-chat-lite. They pasted a short trace showing batch_wait_ms ~130 and several kv_misses.
sam (eng-sre): Infra shows brief autoscaler churn at ~16:12 and a KV shard rebalance right after -> cold-kv on some pods. Also queue depth hit burst throttle briefly causing 429s.
lina (solutions): For immediate customer guidance: 1) try client-side prefill_tokens:1-2; 2) run trace command and paste output. Prefill often reduces first-token pain.
ben (eng-runtime): Suggested quick config: batch_window_ms=8 (was 50), max_batch_size=10, min_replicas=2, enable kv_prefetch for top prefixes. This lowers TTFT at some throughput cost. Shall I roll?
olivia (sales): Please roll. Cedar also asked if Dedicated solves this and pricing impact of lowering batch window.
freya (acct exec): Dedicated avoids noisy-neighbor churn; offer: 3-month trial at 15% off + 5k demo credits. I'll DM formal numbers and include a warmup onboarding run.
credits-bot: applied 5000 demo credits to cedarbank@example.com @ 2147000023
ben (eng-runtime): Ask Cedar to run this trace and paste the JSON so we can correlate requestId->pod logs:
````
curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-chat-lite\",\"input\":\"<sample>\",\"trace\":true}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer | jq .trace
````
That includes batch_wait_ms and kv_hits/misses.
sam (eng-sre): I'll pin min_replicas and add a pod warmup job to prepopulate KV for their top 30 prefixes during the rollout. That should reduce kv_misses.
lina (solutions): I'll attach SOC2/KMS summary and a short runbook with the config snippet for them.
olivia (sales): Cedar pasted a sample trace: {"req":"r-7f1","batch_wait_ms":132,"kv_hits":0,"kv_misses":5,"model_ms":29} 
ben (eng-runtime): Confirms pattern. After rollout expect batch_wait_ms <25ms; kv_misses should drop after warmup. If still bad we can pin to the smaller quantized variant for the demo.
freya (acct exec): If they commit to Dedicated, include a one-time warm-standby prewarm to avoid cold-shard misses (small onboarding fee).
olivia (sales): Rolling change now and will update Cedar on the call. Thanks all :thumbsup:
